name: MonarchLocationFields
title: LocationFields
wrapsNative: MonarchCountrySelect and MonarchRegionSelect (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a menu or androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet), a MonarchCombobox sheet for the city search, and MonarchTextField (androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField) with ContentType.AddressLocality and ContentType.PostalCode, stacked in androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
summary: Country, region, city and postal code as one address block, with the city list (and optionally the country and region lists) supplied by the app through an adapter.
whenToUse: In an address, billing or shipping form that stores the country and region as codes and the city from the product's own place data or as typed text.
whenNotToUse: For one address search with suggestions use MonarchAddressAutocomplete; for only a country or only a region use MonarchCountrySelect or MonarchRegionSelect.
api: @Composable fun MonarchLocationFields(value: MonarchLocationValue, onValueChange: (value: MonarchLocationValue, changed: MonarchLocationField) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, adapter: MonarchLocationAdapter = MonarchLocationAdapter(), fields: List<MonarchLocationField> = MonarchLocationField.entries, errors: Map<MonarchLocationField, String> = emptyMap(), enabled: Boolean = true, legend: String? = null, locale: Locale? = null, cityMinQuery: Int = 2, cityDebounceMillis: Long = 250L, allowCustomCity: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchLocationFieldsLabels = MonarchLocationFieldsLabels())
data class MonarchLocationValue(val country: String? = null, val region: String? = null, val regionName: String = "", val city: String = "", val cityId: String? = null, val postalCode: String = "")
enum class MonarchLocationField { Country, Region, City, PostalCode }

class MonarchLocationAdapter(val countries: List<String>? = null, val regions: (suspend (country: String) -> List<MonarchRegionSelectRegion>)? = null, val regionLabel: ((country: String) -> String?)? = null, val cities: (suspend (query: MonarchLocationCityQuery) -> List<MonarchLocationCity>)? = null)
class MonarchLocationCity(val id: String, val name: String, val description: String? = null, val region: MonarchRegionSelectRegion? = null)
data class MonarchLocationCityQuery(val country: String, val region: String?, val query: String)

class MonarchLocationFieldsLabels(country: String? = null, region: String? = null, city: String? = null, postalCode: String? = null, chooseCountryFirst: String? = null, typeMore: ((minLength: Int) -> String)? = null, noMatch: String? = null, citiesLoadFailed: String? = null, useTyped: ((text: String) -> String)? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: value
options.description: The address: country and region codes, region and city as read, the city id when chosen from the list, and the postal code. The app keeps it.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the whole new address and the part that changed. A new country clears every other part; a new region clears the city.

options.name: adapter
options.description: Where the lists come from: countries to offer, a region loader and the country's word for its regions, and the city search. Without a city search the city is a text field.

options.name: fields
options.description: The parts to show, in order.

options.name: errors
options.description: An error message per part; that field is in the error state.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the fields can be used.

options.name: legend
options.description: A heading above the fields, such as "Shipping address".

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the country names and their order; null uses the configuration's first locale.

options.name: cityMinQuery
options.description: The letters needed before cities are searched while no region is chosen.

options.name: cityDebounceMillis
options.description: The wait after the last keystroke before cities are searched.

options.name: allowCustomCity
options.description: Offers "Use “text”" for a city that is not in the list; it is stored with a null cityId.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the field labels and the city list messages.

states.name: no country
states.description: The region field is disabled and says "Choose a country first"; so does the city search. A city text field stays usable.

states.name: region list
states.description: For a country with a list (built in, or from adapter.regions) the region is a combobox under the country's own word; otherwise a text field.

states.name: loading
states.description: The region combobox and the city list show their loading state while the adapter answers.

states.name: too short
states.description: Without a region, the city list says "Type at least 2 letters to search." and nothing is searched.

states.name: search failed
states.description: The city list says "Couldn’t load cities. Type again to retry."; the next keystroke searches again. A failed region load shows MonarchRegionSelect's Try again.

states.name: error
states.description: A field with a message in errors shows it under the field in the danger color.

appearance: Each field keeps its own appearance: MonarchTextField's surface fill and input border, the danger strong color in error, and the combobox list on the surface color with muted second lines. The legend is a subheading in the default text color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web LocationFields lays the four fields in a responsive grid inside a fieldset and takes an adapter whose countries, regions and cities calls are promises with an AbortSignal. On Android the fields stack in one column, as address forms do on a phone; the adapter's functions are suspending and a newer request cancels the older coroutine. The country list is synchronous here: MonarchCountrySelect names every ISO country in the locale, and adapter.countries only limits it. adapter.regions is optional because MonarchRegionSelect has built-in lists, and the country's word for its regions is adapter.regionLabel instead of a field of the regions answer. The city search opens a bottom sheet (MonarchCombobox's sheet), not an inline list. The web's required marks and the uncontrolled defaultValue are not offered: the value is always hoisted, and the app shows required errors through errors. The web's Try again button after a failed city search is replaced by searching again on the next keystroke. No iOS entry exists yet.
accessibility: The fields form one traversal group; the legend is a heading.
Each field has a visible label that TalkBack reads as its name; the region field is named by the country's word for its regions.
Errors are shown under their field and read with it.
Each field carries its autofill type (country through MonarchCountrySelect, region, city as AddressLocality, postal code as PostalCode).
Every field is at least 48dp tall.
edgeCases: Changing the country clears the region, city and postal code; choosing the same country again changes nothing.
A city chosen before a region fills the region from the city; a region already chosen is kept.
A typed city is stored with cityId = null; a chosen city keeps its id and stays shown even when it is not in the latest results.
Without adapter.cities the city is a plain text field.
With adapter.regions, a country whose loader returns no regions gets a text field.

examples.title: Controlled address
examples.template:
MonarchLocationFields(
    value = address,
    onValueChange = { next, _ -> address = next },
    legend = {{legend}},
    labels = MonarchLocationFieldsLabels(region = "Province"),
    required = setOf(MonarchLocationField.Country, MonarchLocationField.City),
)
examples.setupTemplate: var address by remember { mutableStateOf(MonarchLocationValue(country = {{value.country}}, region = {{value.region}}, regionName = {{value.regionName}}, city = {{value.city}}, cityId = {{value.cityId}}, postalCode = {{value.postalCode}})) }
examples.setup: var address by remember { mutableStateOf(MonarchLocationValue(country = "CA", region = "CA-ON", regionName = "Ontario", city = "Toronto", cityId = "ca-tor", postalCode = "")) }
examples.code:
MonarchLocationFields(
    value = address,
    onValueChange = { next, _ -> address = next },
    legend = "Billing address",
    labels = MonarchLocationFieldsLabels(region = "Province"),
    required = setOf(MonarchLocationField.Country, MonarchLocationField.City),
)

examples.title: Some parts, with errors
examples.code:
MonarchLocationFields(
    value = address,
    onValueChange = { next, _ -> address = next },
    fields = listOf(MonarchLocationField.City, MonarchLocationField.PostalCode),
    errors = mapOf(MonarchLocationField.PostalCode to "Enter a postal code."),
)

parityExceptions.reason: NATIVE GAP: the Android MonarchLocationFields has no required parameter, so the web required marks on Country and City are not drawn; the app shows required errors through errors.
